Initial release of tock-mcp: discover and browse restaurants on Tock via MCP.

- Provides read-only access to Tock restaurant listings, venue details, bookable experiences, prices, and availability.
- Tools to list metros, search restaurants, fetch venue details, check availability, and (for signed-in users) view profile/purchases.
- Works by relaying requests through the user's signed-in browser tab with the fetchproxy extension—no credentials needed.
- Installation and pairing process requires both the MCP server and fetchproxy browser extension.
- Tock reservations remain booked directly on exploretock.com; no booking or payment via this tool.
